title: Gardeners' Guild — claimed by storm
description: US · Agriculture and Food Production · Gardeners' Guild is a full-service landscaping company based in the SF Bay Area, specializing in both interior and exterior landscape maintenance and construction. Founded in 1972 and employee-owned, they offer a range of services including irrigation repair, sustainable landscaping, and fire fuel reduction.
